title: Canton solvency report anchor v1
description: One report's place in a publisher's history (SPEC.md §12). A history file is an array of these, oldest first. Anchors carry digests and offsets only, never balances: an amount on a ledger contract is disclosed to every observer.

prev_anchor.description: Digest of the previous anchor. Absent only for the first; an absent predecessor and an empty one are distinguished by the digest rule.

publisher_key.description: The Ed25519 key that signed the anchored report. A reader who can see the anchor obtains the key from the ledger rather than from the server that served the report (SPEC.md §8.4).
